en: The postcard features a vintage photograph of a tranquil waterscape at dawn, with small boats on the water and a basic wooden dock in the foreground. The text on the front reads 'Варна Утро / Varna Matin,' indicating the scene is from Varna in the morning. On the reverse side, there is handwritten correspondence in Bulgarian, a postage stamp with a portrait, and postal marks. Partial printed information and handwritten address details are visible.
